description: This PHP source file defines a class for migrating logged delivery data from plugin bucket tables to statistics tables during maintenance operations in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for locating relevant components, preparing migration maps, handling post-upgrade raw data migration, and executing data summarization and pruning.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Statistics_Task_MigrateBucketData
classes.description: A class responsible for migrating logged delivery data from plugin bucket tables to statistics tables, including handling post-upgrade raw data migration, component location, and data pruning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list of installed plugin packages.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method that performs data migration, including locating components, preparing migration maps, executing migrations, and pruning data.

methods.name: _locateComponents
methods.description: Private method that finds and instantiates all plugin components using the deliveryLog extension, grouped by their destination statistics table.

methods.name: _prepareMaps
methods.description: Private method that converts located components into migration maps based on the specified migration type ('raw', 'rawSupplementary', 'aggregate', 'custom').

methods.name: _postUpgrade
methods.description: Handles migration of old raw data following an upgrade to OpenX 2.8, by migrating raw requests, impressions, and clicks.

methods.name: _migrateRawRequests
methods.description: Migrates raw request data into bucket format for a specified date range.

methods.name: _migrateRawImpressions
methods.description: Migrates raw impression data into bucket format for a specified date range.

methods.name: _migrateRawClicks
methods.description: Migrates raw click data into bucket format for a specified date range.
